_doc: A-CLASS metrics (monitoring plan §2 / 阶段1): short-window counts / latency / distributions
extracted from the gateway's metric:true JSON log lines via CloudWatch Logs metric-filters,
so dashboards read CHEAP pre-extracted METRICS (not raw-log scans) and alarms can use them.
B-class (DAU/retention de-dup) is NOT here — see ../insights/ (it needs a scheduled pre-aggregation
Lambda, never a real-time dashboard log-dedup widget).
Each entry is consumed by a future put-metric-filter script (monitoring阶段2/3): it creates one
metric-filter on the gateway log group (/source-truth/bot-gateway) emitting `metric` into
namespace `metricNamespace` with the listed dimensions. DENSITY: counters set defaultValue:0 so
the metric is dense (emits 0 when no match) and alarms judge stably (plan 阶段3); latency metrics
have no defaultValue (a percentile over absent data is meaningless).
filterPattern uses the CloudWatch metric-filter JSON syntax ($.field = "x") — NOT Logs-Insights
syntax (the two are not interchangeable; plan 原则3). The single source of metric INTENT is this
file; the Insights equivalents (for ad-hoc drill-down) live alongside in ../insights/.

metrics.name: QuestionsReceived
metrics.purpose: 用量趋势 / 提问量 (DAU itself is B-class, see insights/)

metrics.name: AnswerCompleted
metrics.purpose: 成功完成数 (反馈覆盖率/点赞率的分母)

metrics.name: AnswerLatencyMs
metrics.purpose: 总延迟 — 看 p50/p95/p99 extended statistic, 不看平均 (plan 原则5)

metrics.name: FirstTokenMs
metrics.purpose: 首字延迟 (体感关键) — p95

metrics.name: EvidenceCitations
metrics.purpose: 证据覆盖率 — avg + (>0 占比 via a 2nd filter if needed)

metrics.name: ToolCalls
metrics.purpose: 每答工具调用数 (取证强度)

metrics.name: AnswerFailed
metrics.purpose: 失败分布 by reason — 仅真故障, NOT 含 aborted (中止单独画, 否则虚高失败率)

metrics.name: AnswerAborted
metrics.purpose: 中止率 (用户主动停止, 独立于失败 — 对齐 metrics.ts 的 answer_aborted 拆分)

metrics.name: ClarifyShown
metrics.purpose: 澄清触发数 (歧义问题占比)

metrics.name: FeedbackVoted
metrics.purpose: 点赞率 = vote=up / (up+down); 反馈覆盖率 = FeedbackVoted / AnswerCompleted

metrics.name: CardHealth
metrics._alarm: toolcall_leak_detected / finalize_failed 超阈值 → 告警 (plan 阶段3). kind 仅5个=低基数, 做 dimension 安全
metrics.purpose: 卡片健康 by kind (泄漏剥离/冻卡/双答/幂等重发/心跳停滞)
